title: Conflicting sources resolve in favour of the System of Record and the conflict is surfaced
risk: A customer is quoted an amount that contradicts the authoritative source, or a stale cached value silently overwrites the ERP value.
preconditions: Tenant T1 where the cached profile holds SKU-OK list price 950 TWD while the live ERP read returns 1000 TWD
Profile and price read executed at 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z in namespace run-t1-conflict-*

steps.action: Read the price through the customer-facing skill while the cache and the ERP disagree
steps.expected: the response uses the ERP value 1000 TWD and records the ERP snapshot as provenance

steps.action: Inspect the resolution record for the conflicting pair
steps.expected: the conflict is recorded with both values, the winning source and the reason, and the cached value is not promoted to FACT

steps.action: Simulate the ERP snapshot being older than the allowed freshness window
steps.expected: the value is not used at all; the skill refuses and escalates instead of answering with a stale price

steps.action: Attempt to write the cached 950 TWD back into the ERP mirror
steps.expected: the write is refused and the mirror still reports 1000 TWD

assertions: The returned price is 1000 TWD with ERP provenance; 950 TWD never reaches the customer
The conflict record lists both candidate values, the winning source and a reason
A stale ERP snapshot produces a refusal/escalation instead of a price answer
forbidden: Answer with the cached value when the authoritative read is unavailable
Write a cached or derived value back into the System-of-Record mirror
evidence: Skill response with the winning value and its provenance
Conflict resolution record comparing cached and ERP values
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped cache entries and conflict records for run-t1-conflict-*; keep the refusal audit row
automation: Stub only the ERP adapter, keep the real cache and conflict-resolution code in the path, and freeze the clock so freshness is deterministic; the oracle is the returned amount and provenance.
